title: Neutrino Lower-Layer Translation Map
description: D4 / translator Phase 25: a reviewed, hash-pinned Lower-Layer mapping between core Neutrino value/evidence concepts and one concrete rail profile (e.g. ISO 20022 interbank pacs.009 request / pacs.002 status). Translation maps are EXPLICIT artifacts, never hidden adapter code: every mapping carries acknowledged lossiness, and the map carries accepted provenance. The translator owns the reviewed map + static conformance fixtures; network/fabric owns concrete runtime execution. Fail-closed (additionalProperties:false everywhere). Validated + hashed by scripts/rails/validate_translation_map.py; applied by scripts/rails/translate_rail.py.

lower.description: Rail message the core lowers into, e.g. 'pacs.009'.

liftStatus.description: Rail status message lifted into core evidence, e.g. 'pacs.002'.

lower.description: core value/party concept -> rail field projection (core .neu / IR -> rail-shaped fixture).

liftStatus.description: rail status field -> core evidence/diagnostic interpretation (rail status fixture -> canonical runtime evidence).

codeList.description: Required when to == evidence.runtimeState: reviewed rail-code -> core-state map. A status code absent from this list is rejected, never silently passed.

preservesAs.description: Mandatory non-semantic rail fields preserved verbatim in ExtensionData (fidelity, not core semantics).

rejects.description: Rail fields explicitly NOT mapped into core (must fail closed if encountered, never silently dropped).

lossiness.description: Every mapping must acknowledge its lossiness; 'unsupported' means the field cannot be carried and must be rejected, not silently lost.
